notes: Fixes a lockout bug in 1.18.0: right after installing that update but before clicking 'Update database', the is_super_admin column the new access checks relied on didn't exist yet - which made the Panel Update page itself (and everything else) return 403 for everyone, with no way back in through the panel. Access checks now degrade to 'allow' when the relevant column is missing, exactly like this app's other lag-tolerant checks (is_ai_guessed, missed_syncs) - so a fresh install of a migration-requiring update can never lock an admin out of the one page that runs migrations. If you're only just now installing an update for the first time since 1.18.0 shipped, run 'Update database' immediately after this install and you're set - no SQL needed.
